text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the mock race—has finally arrived.
choice_data_list: (We've refined our preparations down to the finest detail for today...)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
The latest data on Craft and the others...?
Incredible, you were gathering intel right up to the very last second.
choice_data_list: Let's build your strategy based on this.
Let's build your strategy based on this.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, having such an exceptional Trainer in my corner...
is far more reassuring than I ever imagined.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
—You read my mind, and you put it into words.
Let's go claim our victory. Together, the two of us!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leading up to the real thing, I made meticulous adjustments
as her temporary Trainer, watching over Daring Heart.
All of it—for today.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Such a sharp, tense expression...
Are you the one about to race, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Sorry, I just got a little nervous...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Say... who do you think I am?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her fearless smile instantly melted away all the tension in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is waiting. Waiting for me to cast aside hesitation
and call out the name destined to seize glorious victory—

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Be daring. Come... let me hear it.
The name of the Queen you believe in.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: Go on, say it!
choice_data_list: Show them what you're made of—"Daring Heart"!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'm off!
To take the very first step... toward my Queendom!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a flawless start, Daring Heart boldly pushes to the front.
She dictates the pace with confident, composed running.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah—

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah...!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
(...I can hear it. The rush of the wind, the turf beneath my feet.
The breath of my rivals—...Ah, not yet. Don't rush it.)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
(...Theory backs up my instincts. Just like the data you gave me,
I'm the one controlling this pace...)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Stay calm... No wasted effort.
Just wait for that moment—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And in the final stretch, the pack makes its decisive move—!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Now—! Haaaaaahhh—!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Tch—...!!
HAAAAAHHHHH—!!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
(—Here they come. Those footsteps, that pressure...
Ah, it's thrilling...!)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
(This is the world I've been yearning for. Noble, gritty,
a clash of exposed spirits... heart to heart—!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart had conserved every ounce of strength until now.
—All to blow past her formidable rivals with explosive power!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
(My wings are rested. My heart is full.
All that's left... is to fly higher than anyone else!)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Look at me! Don't you dare look away!
Right here, right now... I am the brightest Queen in the world!!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Go... Daring Heart—!!
HAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh, haah...!
Haah..., haah..., haah...!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
———...Kh!
She overtook me... She passed me—...kh!!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: I was right there... Just a few more steps, and—...
choice_data_list: That was an amazing run... especially that final spurt!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
No matter how close it was, a loss is still a loss.
—I couldn't reach victory.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe... But you know, I feel refreshed.
Yes, truly... I feel great.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if to hide her trembling fingertips and crush her frustration,
Daring Heart clenched her fists tightly.
choice_data_list: (...She doesn't need clumsy words of comfort.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Making up my mind, I quietly stepped up to her side.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's funny... Whenever you touch me,
all the tension in my shoulders just... melts away.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: Are your hands... magic or something?
choice_data_list: They're just... the hands of a big worrywart.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
No... They feel like my favorite blanket.
So warm... gently wrapping around me.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Your hands give me peace of mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—If these hands can support her.
I felt like, just for now, I was allowed to indulge in that happy thought.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you brought that bike again... Riding alongside me today too, right?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
I've got a few things I want to test out today as well.
Let's get going! Come on, let's head out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without looking back, Daring Heart accelerates
toward her ideals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day I chased after her running for the very first time.
Seeing her dash ahead with untouchable sharpness made me feel so outmatched.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She felt impossibly distant. Utterly overwhelming.
And yet—it set my heart ablaze. I was hopelessly captivated by her running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I pushed hard on the pedals. At that moment—

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: Let's ride together, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: Hehe... What's with that funny face?!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
You were the one who told me, weren't you?
That leaning too far forward isn't good.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
So... I thought maybe it wouldn't hurt to match my pace
and move forward together with someone.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: ...You said that only by resting your wings can you truly soar high.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
I want to become stronger.
With a stronger heart—I want to fly higher than ever.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
So...
Will you be my perch?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: —Be my partner... as my official Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I will support and watch over her.
Until this beautiful, noble heart reaches the tiara—
choice_data_list: Yeah... Let's soar into the sky together—!
Yeah... Let's soar into the sky together—!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hehe...! The breeze feels wonderful.
What a truly gorgeous morning...!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: A perfect start... together with you♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Soft morning sunlight showers down on us.
Along the path toward dazzling glory... the two of us start running at the same speed.
